description: Source code for Android's IStreamSource interface implementation, including proxy and binder classes, handling media stream source communication via IPC.

classes.name: BpStreamSource
classes.description: Proxy class for IStreamSource, enabling IPC calls to set listener, set buffers, and notify buffer availability.

classes.name: BnStreamSource
classes.description: Binder class handling incoming transactions for IStreamSource, dispatching to appropriate methods.

classes.name: BpStreamListener
classes.description: Proxy class for IStreamListener, enabling IPC calls to queue buffers and issue commands.

classes.name: BnStreamListener
classes.description: Binder class handling incoming transactions for IStreamListener, dispatching to queueBuffer and issueCommand.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the stream listener via IPC.

methods.name: setBuffers
methods.description: Sets the buffer list via IPC.

methods.name: onBufferAvailable
methods.description: Notifies that a buffer is available via IPC.

methods.name: queueBuffer
methods.description: Queues a buffer with specified index and size via IPC.

methods.name: issueCommand
methods.description: Issues a command with optional message via IPC.
